approach: Fix the definition, never the section name — git history shows the entry-point reading was authored at origin (ba974085) and the owner has read it as a use case since; renaming would entrench the smaller job

Constrain every candidate shape to gradable-from-the-document — the spec gate is a cold judge, so facilitation rituals (event storming, JTBD interviews, BMAD elicitation) are out of reach whatever their merit
Carry the entry-point rows forward rather than replacing them; they are correct and the CR adds to them
Hold the 85-node corpus backfill out (#436) so legacy debt never blocks an in-flight CR
Land the grading duty across Oracle, Builder and Architect per owner ruling, not in Oracle alone as first scoped
Route confidence-derivation, bar-invocation timing, and claim provenance to follow-ups — each is its own CR

The judge re-derived both round-1 remediations independently rather than accepting them: it re-ran the revised-node sweep (5 revised, 4 reference-type, so the single instance was the complete set) and the mirrored-duty sweep across all three new bar duties. It checked the node's surface trace 1:1 against the governance's actual Inputs block and found no invented element, and confirmed all 8 stated extensions map to real procedure text and each carries a scenario. It pressed the two struck self-defects for work-dodging and cleared both on independent evidence — the USER_INPUT/BACKFILL pair reads as a precedence in step 1 rather than a refusal, and the Clearance stop is already specified on mission/conductor, the node that owns it. why.conformance: warn — authoring/spec-producer carries no ## What, ## Control Flow or ## Scenario map. Confirmed pre-existing at origin/main and non-blocking; deriving a CFG here would be a retrofit against prose written in this same CR, so it rides the follow-up machinery

note: The authoring/spec-producer node carries no ## What, ## Control Flow or ## Scenario map. Pre-existing at the merge base and surfaced by both gates as a non-blocking conformance warning. Deriving a CFG inside this CR would retrofit it against prose the same CR authored, which is the shape that has diverged before.

Extend the scope and structural-fit bars to judge the SHAPE of a designed surface, not only that each element traces to a use case: minimality, orthogonality, consistent naming. Traceability answers whether an element is justified; it does not answer whether the set of elements is well formed, which is the half of the reported defect this CR does not reach.

Guide a project through binding its own scope, coverage and structural-fit bars at onboarding. Five roles and five bars are bindable per artifact-type today, but nothing walks an adopter through choosing them, so every project inherits the defaults by default rather than by decision. Open question recorded: the doctrine and structure delegates are not bindable at all, and whether they should be is undecided.

Derive the confidence dimension from measurable inputs instead of free prose. Blast already has an engine that computes it and flags an under- or over-called declaration; confidence is self-asserted and unchecked, and it is the dimension that decides whether an agent proceeds alone or stops for a human.

Reconsider when the actor bars are invoked. They run twice, both times over the artifact as it stands, so a judge can confirm every element is covered but can never ask whether an element should exist. The design record that would carry that interrogation is optional, ungated and out of the judge's view, and two of the corpus's change requests have written one.

Require a problem claim to carry its source: reported by the request, observed with a citation, or assumed. Evidenced by one reverted change request that passed both gates and a mutation sweep on a situation that had already been adjudicated, and by a second whose stale premise was caught only because the producer went and measured. Nothing at the gate distinguished the two.

why.floor: clearance — GRANTED IN SESSION by the owner, recorded before the edit. Re-opens the frozen spec-producer suite to REWRITE scenario 8 (a stated divergence carries its own scenario in the suite) and to route scenario 9 the same way. This is a narrowing of agreed contract, not an additive scenario, so it is the owner's call and is not self-asserted. Reason: the round-2 gates both passed, and the owner then found a defect neither judge was positioned to see — the CR created a SECOND source for the scenario set. The standing rule derives scenarios from the CFG's edges with the map 1:1 on (path class, edge); the CR added every stated extension has a scenario, at a different granularity and from a rival source. That is the knowledge duplication the structural bar forbids, and it risks inverting the derivation direction this corpus already learned the hard way, where a map built by finding an edge for each existing scenario was 1:1 by construction and could not surface a hole. Correct model: the actor-centric extension search COMPLETES the CFG, and the CFG remains the sole source the scenarios derive from
why.blast: medium — the scope of the re-open is the two scenarios that encode the rival source plus the bar text that states it; the CFG and scenario-map contracts are untouched
why.novelty: low — it restores the standing derivation direction rather than introducing one
why.confidence: high — the owner identified the defect directly and both judges' round-2 records confirm neither tested it: no scenario exercises a divergence outside the stated set, so the rival source was invisible to the suite by construction

why: Scope folded in by owner decision: use-case DISCOVERY joins this CR rather than a follow-up. Measured gap that motivated it — after the first pass, all three discovery inputs remain anchored on the surface or the request. The producer procedure warns that deriving a use case from the interface reproduces the interface, then instructs the reader to walk each ENTRY POINT and ask who invokes it, which enumerates only use cases an interface already implies. Seed intent asks for the public interface as an input. Backfill reads source, tests and history, which by construction recovers only the use cases already served. Neither the scope nor the structural-fit bar carries any discovery obligation at all — every bullet in both is a backward judgment on an artifact that already exists, which is correct for a grader and leaves discovery unowned.
